live.hint: Raw, unfiltered probe reading — watch this while you jog a nozzle over the coil to sanity-check the sensor before trusting an automated scan.

setup.fitMethodHint: Weighted quadratic is immune to a DC-offset signal and handles a valley-shaped response natively. A detected valley auto-switches to it regardless of this setting — the results table shows a note when that happens.

reference.zeroReference: Scan the reference tool fresh (ignore its current G10)
reference.zeroReferenceHint: The reference tool still gets scanned via its own Scan button — this just stops its offset from inheriting its current G10, so a from-scratch calibration doesn't silently trust a value nobody has verified. Turn off to keep the reference tool's existing offset unchanged instead.
reference.captureDatumHint: Jog the bare carriage to trigger your fixed reference (e.g. a homing switch that never touches a tool), then click Capture — this just reads the current machine position, no coil measurement involved.
